name: First Signal
story: Beyond the white bench, a scout blocks the road.
tutorialBriefing: Choose two different numbers. Their sum replaces your first number; keep only its last digit.
tutorialRule: TURN 01  /  Choose two numbers. Their sum becomes your first number.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: They leave the bench together. Beneath a broken arch, a scout raises its hand and closes the way.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: Choose your first number, then a different number on any living card. Add them. Keep the last digit of the sum.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith offers her his waterskin. She wipes the mouth of it before drinking. He notices, but says nothing.

name: Hold the Crossing
story: A guard waits where the road crosses a shallow channel.
tutorialBriefing: Equip a skill within the SP budget. Skills trigger automatically when their conditions are met.
tutorialRule: LOADOUT  /  SP is your skill budget. Skills trigger automatically when their condition is met.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: We will have to go through. Equip a skill within the SP budget. Skills act when their conditions are met.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: Take your time. We can choose differently next time.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: I think there was water where I was going. I cannot remember which side I was on.

name: Silence the Echo
story: A captain holds the narrow passage. More footsteps approach.
tutorialBriefing: Watch for reinforcement arrivals. Defeat the entire hostile squad to open the road.
tutorialRule: FIELD  /  Defeat every enemy. Reinforcements may join before the encounter ends.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The road narrows between two walls. A captain waits with a guard; another pair of footsteps sounds beyond them.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: Watch the whole field. A reinforcement can arrive when an enemy falls. Clear the whole hostile squad before we move on.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: None looks familiar. That does not mean none will take us there.
